user_input: How many HashiCorp products were purchased in 2025?
retrieved_contexts: Total HashiCorp products purchased in 2025: 8 products
Data source: Client opportunity records with 'Closed Won' status in 2025

Query executed: MATCH (c:Client)-[o:OPPORTUNITY]->(p:Product) WHERE toLower(p.name) CONTAINS 'hashicorp' AND o.opportunity_stage = 'Closed Won' AND o.close_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.close_date < '2026-01-01' AND toLower(p.vendor) CONTAINS 'hashicorp' RETURN count(*) as total_purchases
response: In 2025, 8 HashiCorp products were purchased by clients.
reference: In 2025, 8 HashiCorp products were purchased by various clients across different deals.
